skills.name: stott-pro-articles
skills.description: Find and read Mark Stott's articles on www.stott.pro about Optimizely CMS, .NET development, and his Stott Security and Stott Robots Handler add-ons. Use when a question may be answered by this blog, or when you need release notes or the latest version of either add-on.

skills.name: stott-security-setup
skills.description: Install and register the Stott Security add-on in an Optimizely CMS 12 or CMS 13 (PaaS) solution, covering the NuGet package, service registration, middleware order, authorisation and nonce tag helpers. Use when adding Stott Security to a .NET Optimizely CMS project or fixing its start-up configuration.

skills.name: stott-robots-handler-setup
skills.description: Install and register the Stott Robots Handler add-on in an Optimizely CMS 12 or CMS 13 (PaaS) solution, to manage robots.txt, llms.txt and environment robots meta tags and headers from the CMS. Use when adding Stott Robots Handler to a .NET Optimizely CMS project, configuring its authorisation, upgrading it to CMS 13, or connecting its agent tools.
